title_en: Artificial Intelligence (3/20): AI in the Doctor's Office
note_en: A verb plus a result or direction complement packs an action and its outcome into one word: 标出 "mark out," 识别出来 "pick out," 腾出 "free up." English often does the same with phrasal verbs, and the negative works through 没能 or an inserted 不: 算不出病人心里的担心 "can't calculate (out) the worries in a patient's heart."
